purpose: Editable collection artwork; no tokens are minted by this tool.
historicalNote: Fictional, stylized appearances. Euclid and Cleomenes are not authenticated portraits. Visual colors and costumes are art direction, not NFT rarity assignments. Five artwork variants do not allocate the five historical-figure token copies.

characters.title: Alexander, the conqueror
characters.summary: Born to royal kin, a commander who reached the rank of general and earned a recorded military distinction while still young.

characters.title: Aristotle, the philosopher
characters.summary: A widely read teacher of argument who tutored students or advised the court and left a remembered philosophical work.

characters.title: Euclid, the geometer
characters.summary: A careful reckoner and reader who worked among tables and demonstrations and left a credited piece of scholarship.

characters.title: Cleomenes of Naucratis, the grain administrator
characters.summary: A trader or court official with a head for accounts who grew rich and closed recorded commercial agreements.

characters.title: Scholar of Alexandria
characters.summary: A teacher took you in hand for a season and drilled your letters. A reader lent you a book roll and talked it over with you.

characters.title: Soldier of Alexandria
characters.summary: A veteran took you under his wing and taught you to keep your footing. A soldier warned you that the recruiters were coming, so you put food and silver aside.

characters.title: Trader of Alexandria
characters.summary: A merchant extended you credit on easy terms when you needed it. A trader hired you for a season of paid work at the quays.

characters.title: Craftworker of Alexandria
characters.summary: A workshop master took you on and taught you the trade's first skills. A craftsman shared part of a paid commission with you.

characters.title: Stargazer of Alexandria
characters.summary: An interpreter of the sky read a favourable omen for you. A sky-watcher warned of a hard year, and your household stored food against it.

characters.title: Performer of Alexandria
characters.summary: A musician's playing lifted your spirits through a hard week. A troupe of performers lent your household a hand when it was struggling.
